hover.trigger: pointer enters an enabled control or link
hover.effect: Show or thicken the lime underline on ink chrome, or darken the action surface, without shifting layout.
hover.reducedMotion: Show the final underline and surface immediately.

press.effect: Change the surface immediately; no bounce or large scale.

tilt.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on an act card
tilt.effect: Tilt the card a few degrees; the act name, badges, time, and focus ring stay fully visible and uncovered.
tilt.reducedMotion: No tilt. The card stays flat with the same focus ring and content, and tilt is also off whenever motion is paused.

drift.trigger: Home hero and campaign bands render while motion is playing
drift.effect: Decorative stickers drift slowly within their margins; they never move over text, controls, or focus rings and never flash.
drift.reducedMotion: Stickers are still in their resting positions. The same state applies when the Pause motion toggle is on.

wordmark.trigger: the campaign wordmark enters the Home campaign layout while motion is playing
wordmark.effect: The expanding campaign wordmark widens its letters with type and CSS transforms, once; the header and ticket wordmark stays fixed.
wordmark.reducedMotion: Render the final expanded wordmark statically, with no transform animation.

reveal.trigger: a secondary campaign section first enters the viewport
reveal.effect: Reveal once with opacity and a short vertical travel; transactional sections do not reveal.
reveal.reducedMotion: Render the final state immediately with no translation or stagger.

menu.trigger: the mobile Menu or Close button
menu.effect: Slide the full-height ink sheet in as one group; focus moves into the sheet when it is ready.
menu.reducedMotion: Open and close without the slide while preserving focus trap, Esc, scroll lock, and focus return.

skeleton.trigger: lineup, schedule, or availability data is loading
skeleton.effect: Skeleton cards or rows may shimmer gently.
skeleton.reducedMotion: Static skeletons with the loading text; no shimmer, including when motion is paused.

global.contentBeforeEnhancement: Visible, usable, and in reading order.
global.colorTransition: Nothing flashes. Color changes are brief state feedback only; no strobing, blinking, or rapidly alternating fills. A persistent Pause motion / Play motion toggle sets one data-motion attribute that all kinetic CSS reads, defaults to paused under reduced motion, and is stored per browser.
